_provenance.redaction: D-03 discipline: template texts are preserved verbatim (they are the mimicry target); the reply text is a shape-preserving stand-in (<reply verbatim>).
_provenance.policy: D-01 (12-CONTEXT): an unanswered AskUserQuestion waits a configurable interval (default 10 minutes; 0 = block forever — interactive mode), then returns a capture-shaped non-answer. The non-answer form is CORPUS-ABSENT (no unanswered AskUserQuestion result exists in any pinned corpus) and follows the documented corpus-informed-default convention, routed exactly like ACP-07's corpus-absent forms.
corpus_absent: ask_non_answer_form — no unanswered AskUserQuestion result observed in any pinned corpus (live rollouts carry zero deferred-tool invocations, per the 12-01 planning corpus check). Documented corpus-informed default per D-01, defined once in internal/session/ask.go RenderAskNonAnswer; UPGRADE POINTER: plan 12-05's re-record replaces it with the captured form if the tour produces one (per D-04's re-record-is-primary finding).

ask_question_client_surface_form — the client-side rendering of the question is UI-side, not part of request/response captures; the surface renderer (coreexec.RenderAskSurface) emits structure (header, question, option labels with descriptions), not judgment — the '(Recommended)' first-option convention is left to the model per the captured schema's own usage notes.

ask_input_keys_live — the input key set is schema-declared (profiles/zcode/tools.json AskUserQuestion input_schema: questions[].{question,header,options[].{label,description},multiSelect}); the rotated corpus cannot re-verify observed usage. 12-05's re-record confirms or corrects this entry.

AskUserQuestion.input_note: schema-declared shape {questions:[{question,header,options:[{label,description}],multiSelect?}]} (see corpus_absent.ask_input_keys_live); parsed best-effort with unknown fields ignored (the 08-08 bashArgs pattern).
